stem: A starts from rest with an acceleration of a<sub>1</sub>. Two seconds later, B starts from rest with an acceleration of a<sub>2</sub>. If the displacement of A in 5<sup>th</sup> second of its motion is same as that of B in the same time interval, then the ratio of accelerations?

assets.alt: Velocity–time graph: A's line starts at t = 0 with acceleration a₁; B's parallel-looking line starts at t = 2 s with a₂. The strip from 4 s to 5 s is shaded: equal areas under both.
